dedupe_keys.name: data and code associated with human induced subsidence exceeds sea level rise in driving future coastal flood exposure in china s greater bay area

description: The research team publishes geospatial data and scripts on land subsidence and coastal flooding in China’s Greater Bay Area. Zenodo supplies three archives free under CC BY 4.0: mapped data, analysis code and example LISFLOOD-FP configurations. Inputs include a Sentinel-1 InSAR vertical-land-motion rate field and modelled inundation depths for a 2023 baseline and a 2050 projection. These layers can drive coastal exposure and adaptation simulations for roads, buildings or utilities. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Coverage is the study’s coastal region and scenario assumptions. The depositor describes example solver files, while LISFLOOD-FP itself is distributed separately. A limitation is that InSAR processing, ground-level datum and future sea-level assumptions affect estimates, and the published impact comparison is not independently verified. No archive was downloaded or flood model run.
